metadata.description: BUG-RELEASE-001: dependsOn was `<pkg>:build` only, never `<pkg>:dist-manifest`. `build` (the tsc build executor / the Vite build executor) unconditionally (re)writes its OWN minimal, un-rebased dist/package.json as a build output (see generate-manifest.js's writeDistManifest doc comment, BUG-BUILD-PUBLISH-DISTMANIFEST-CLOBBERED-001) — so invoking this gate via `build` alone actively CLOBBERS a previously-correct rebased manifest back to the broken source-relative shape and then reports it as failing. `dist-manifest` transitively depends on `build`+`assets` (tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js) and is the one function (writeDistManifest) that both `dist-manifest` and the real `nx-release-publish`/`publish` targets call to materialize a correct dist/package.json — depending on it here (not `build`) makes this diagnostic re-stamp the manifest the same way a real publish does, instead of undoing that stamp.

GATE 1 (pre-publish, offline): asserts every intra-@adhd/* dependency range in the release set resolves against {registry-published versions} ∪ {versions this release will publish}. Wired into `pnpm release`/`release:dry`; blocks publish on failure. See tools/nx-plugins/build/lib/range-resolvability.js.

GATE 2 (post-publish, end-to-end): npm-installs every publishable entrypoint from the real registry in an ephemeral dir + bin smoke, in parallel. See tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/smoke-test/clean-room-smoke.mjs.

Machine check that the push/CI gate's resource-heavy lane (`e2e`) stays reachable and cached — the check that stops the silent-green recurrence. Fails when: a project ships src/**/*.e2e.ts but declares no `e2e` target; any `test.dependsOn` re-couples `e2e`; an `e2e` target is not cache:true with non-empty inputs containing `default`; a publishable project's `e2e` presence disagrees with `publish` reaching `e2e` (the tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js conditional); a gate file (.githooks/pre-push + both CI workflows) fails to invoke every target in GATE_TARGETS (tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs); or a project has a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target (ratcheted in the checker's baseline). Invoked UNCONDITIONALLY by .githooks/pre-push and both workflows BEFORE the lanes; also `nx run @adhd/source:lane-reachability` / `pnpm run check:lane-reachability`.

BUG-ADHD-EE8D24C8-REVERT-001: flags a commit/range whose diff is dominated by deletions of files that already existed at HEAD/base (the proven shape of a stale working tree — e.g. after `git update-ref` moved a branch without updating its tree — committed back over already-fixed files). `.githooks/pre-commit` Gate 0 and `.githooks/post-commit` call the underlying `.githooks/detect-mass-deletion.js` directly (must run pre-node_modules-guaranteed); this target exists so CI/a server-side check can run the IDENTICAL classifier via `nx run @adhd/source:mass-delete-guard --base=<ref> --head=<ref>`, closing the local-hook `--no-verify` blind spot.

CI tree-clean gate (backlog e92e2b92): exits non-zero when `git status --porcelain` is non-empty. Invoked as the last step of the CI `main` job and the PR `test` job, so a job whose commands dirty a tracked file (or leave an untracked one) cannot go green. Uncached: it reads live working-tree state.

Published-vs-source parity (backlog 420a7051): fails when any publishable project's source version is behind its published-state.json version. Pass `--registry` (via the script directly) to compare against the live registry instead. Invoked by the CI `main` job.

Actionable Store demo acceptance runner (backlog ddceb069): seeds an isolated fixture and drives every DEMO.md beat plus the R1-R7 refusal controls through the BUILT backlog CLI. Exit code 1 on any FAIL beat. Invoked by the CI `main` job.
Proves the demo-acceptance gate has teeth (backlog ddceb069): a deliberately broken R-control turns the runner red; the unbroken runner is green. Invoked by the CI `main` job after `demo-acceptance`.

Evidence tooling gate (backlog 65788fd8 D-AC4): drives check-suite-tree-state, commit-mine and audit-closed-items as real processes against throwaway git repos; each tool has a negative control (a broken copy must go red). Exit code gates. Invoked by the CI `main` job.
